turns.q: I want something for everyday use, good quality, and I care about value for money.
turns.replyTail:
For everyday use, the best value depends mainly on your sleeping position, body shape, whether you sleep alone or with a partner, and how warm you feel at night. Tediber’s product sheets and buying guide can help compare these points rather than focusing only on a discount percentage.

To narrow it down for you, what is your main sleeping position, do you sleep alone or as a couple, and do you prefer a firm, balanced or softer feel? Also, which mattress size do you need?

nside the mattress.

If the defect is confirmed and eligible, Tediber provides a repair or replacement. Delivery is covered, and reasonable return costs may be reimbursed with proof. The warranty does not provide a refund.

It excludes normal wear, normal loss of firmness, stains, tears, moisture or mould, personal comfort preferences, and mattresses not unpacked within 30 days of delivery. To make a claim, send a clear description, photos of the issue and proof of purchase to hello@tediber.com.

turns.q: How long will delivery take, roughly?
turns.replyTail:
For a mattress delivered on its own in Metropolitan France, standard delivery is usually within 24 to 48 hours, depending on availability and the delivery address.

If you add old-bedding collection, a room-delivery service or other bulky items, allow roughly 8 to 10 days. Delivery to Europe is generally around 72 hours with the standard service.

The earliest available date for your address will be shown when you select the delivery option.
